headline: Houthis Strike Saudi Ports,
Oil Surges
leads.caption: Port attacks and tanker mine claims keep oil near $95.
facts: Coalition reports a drone intercepted near Jeddah.
Iran’s Guards say two tankers hit mines off Khasab.
Reuters could not independently verify the mine claim.

headline: Thanksgiving Storm Cuts
Power to 836,000
leads.caption: Nor’easter floods the coast and topples power lines.
facts: Macy’s first weather postponement in 100 years.
The parade moves to Saturday at 8:30 a.m. ET.
New Jersey declares a state of emergency.

headline: Record 2,100 Migrants
Reach Canary Islands
leads.caption: More than 2,100 in 15 boats, reported 25 Nov.
facts: The 24-hour record was concentrated on El Hierro.
November arrivals exceed the island’s population.
The 26 Nov update puts the tally at 15,025.

headline: Iranian Drones Kill Two
Italians in Kuwait
leads.caption: Kuwait blames Iran for the strike. Iran denies it.
facts: The two worked for Rheinmetall Italia.
The attack targeted an air-defence station.
Kuwaiti and Pakistani nationals were also injured.

briefs.text: Israeli strikes and gunfire kill 10 in Gaza.
Ukrainian drones hit Russia’s Slavyansk refinery overnight.
Cairo detains driver over 25 Nov tanker crash that killed 31.
China–Cambodia Golden Dragon drills run 25 Nov–9 Dec.
Trump demands probe of pre-midterm US GDP figures.
Indonesia mine flood leaves eight dead, 18 trapped.
Norse Atlantic suspends flights, flags bankruptcy risk.
North Korea expels Swiss envoy (25 Nov, reported 26 Nov).
Bangladesh garment wage rises 36%; fresh protests follow.
Australia–Solomons pact signed 25 Nov, worth A$740m.
Colombia revises Cartagena siege count to 76 captives.

exclusions: Huawei verdict · New York jury ruled on 24 Nov.
UN AI framework call · Made on 23 Nov.
Chen Jining probe · Announced on 24 Nov.
Cairo tanker crash · Occurred on the evening of 25 Nov.
Saudi strike on Hodeidah · Took place on 25 Nov.
Shenzhou-24, tariffs and market plunge · In the 25 Nov entry.
footer: Methodology · Every item date-checked. Counts use one primary region and field per story. Earlier events are dated in context.
Sources · Reuters / AP / AFP and other reporting through 26 Nov 2026 UTC. Dated carryovers are marked.
